description: This file defines the RequestHandler class responsible for managing storage operations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage for applications, as well as managing storage info and synchronization. The class also maintains internal state such as storage info maps, mutexes, and a reference to a remote store object.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: Manages application storage operations, including creation, deletion, and info caching, with thread safety and remote store integration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: SetBaseStoragePath
methods.description: Sets the base directory path for storage.

methods.name: createPersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Creates or initializes the remote store object.

methods.name: releasePersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Releases or cleans up the remote store object.

methods.name: appQuotaSizeProperty
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the quota size for a specific app.

methods.name: populateAppInfoCacheFromStoragePath
methods.description: Populates internal cache with storage info from the storage path.

methods.name: setCurrentService
methods.description: Associates a service with the handler.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for an app with specified size.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage info for an app.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears storage for all apps except exemptions.
